_comment: Sentence Commutation Petition (E1): 4 staged deliveries at the warden terminal after audit tier 2. Amounts are scaled by preset_mult. Gated by balance e1_enabled. Phase 3 also clears audit tier 3 (replaces the old tier-3 wall).

phases.title: Petition I: Filing Fees
phases.letter: The wardens stamp your petition 'received'. Each debt is trimmed by 5%.

phases.title: Petition II: Supporting Evidence
phases.letter: The evidence is filed. Debts drop another 8% and a small allowance arrives.

phases.title: Petition III: Proof of Industry
phases.letter: The wardens inspect your power plant. Debts drop 10% and high-throughput industry is cleared.

phases.title: Petition IV: Debt Settlement
phases.letter: Sentence commutation granted. A quarter of every remaining debt is forgiven.
